answer: One agent tends one canyon station, staking 80 credits. Each epoch it reports echo-return time and whisper level; an auditor replays the public canyon-echo table, and a mismatch over 3% or a reused serial burns the stake. A rented canyon fails: its sable-marked serial fits one station. First filing 41 credits, the k-th 41+8(k-1): 1,000 fakes total 4,037,000 plus 80,000 locked, against at most 40,000 in rewards. An honest agent files once for 41.
